metadata.name: AICostBudget AI API Pricing Dataset
metadata.statistics_scope: public pricing records returned by the public pricing adapter with Pricing V2 enabled
metadata.null_value_meaning: Not listed, not published, not applicable, or not currently available in the dataset; null is not zero.

features.pricing_components: Full conditional pricing components; [] when none apply.
features.pricing_components_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of pricing_components.
features.time_pricing: Structured request-time pricing schedule; null when no temporal pricing applies.
features.time_pricing_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of time_pricing.
features.unit_price: Primary non-token unit price; null for token-priced rows.
features.conditional_usage_allowances: Eligibility-scoped recurring allowances that remain separate from standard paid tiers.
features.conditional_usage_allowances_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of conditional_usage_allowances.
features.model_selection: Independent model-default and explicit-ID support metadata; null when not published.
features.model_selection_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of model_selection.
features.access_status: Independent official API access: public/existing_users_only/invite_only/restricted/unknown; not production selector enforcement.
features.access_checked_at: UTC timestamp of successful access verification, independent of pricing freshness.
features.access_evidence: Official access claim scope, exact official model ID, source reference and URL.
features.access_evidence_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization; appended additive column.
features.binding_evidence_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization; appended additive column.

pricing_components.billing_note: The exact API ID mistral-ocr-4-0 is Deprecated in the model catalog. The official September 29 changelog and catalog metadata document retirement on 2026-09-30 and recommend OCR 4.1 at the same price. Dataset status retired normalizes that documented past schedule; actual authenticated API availability and HTTP 404 behavior have not been tested. No automatic redirect is asserted. The official model catalog itself retains the native historical Standard Basic OCR price of USD $4 per 1,000 pages and separately lists USD $5 per 1,000 Annotated Pages. This Basic OCR-only record preserves the $4 rate as historical through 2026-09-29, rather than substituting successor billing. The $5 annotated-page tariff is separate and is not an OCR surcharge or admitted component here. The current visible pricing table lists OCR 4.1 cached input at $0.40 per 1,000 pages; no OCR 4.0-specific cached or numeric Batch charge is inferred. /v1/batch is a documented feature, not proof of a Batch tariff. Native history is display-only and not eligible for current calculation.

pricing_components.billing_note: Published-rate reconciliation, not a provider price increase: the official Batch pricing table directly lists kimi-k2.6 cached input at USD $0.10 per 1M tokens. The same page states Batch inference costs are 60% of standard pricing; Standard cached input is USD $0.16 per 1M tokens, so the derived value is 0.16 x 0.60 = 0.096. The Dataset published price uses the explicit table value 0.10 instead of that derivation. BILLING PRECISION UNCONFIRMED: whether actual invoices retain three decimal places has not been verified. No internal rounding algorithm or invoice-verified settlement rate is asserted. Prices exclude applicable taxes. The observation time is not a new provider effective date.
